JPM.rationale: JPM's fundamental health is unimpeachable: 31% net margin, 39.8% operating margin, 15.5% ROE, record 2025 revenue of $185.6B, and Q1 2026 adjusted EPS of $5.94 beating $5.45 consensus by 9%. The franchise is best-in-class with #1 IB wallet share, $7.1T in AWM assets, and ROTCE of 19-20% well above peers. However, the stock has already re-rated 27% (PE from 13.2x to 16.7x) on essentially flat trailing earnings, pushing valuation to the upper end of its one-year range (P/B 2.60x near the 2.8x ceiling). The entire return came from multiple expansion, not earnings growth. The oil shock ($108.64 WTI) introduces material credit risk that the elevated valuation does not discount. Basel III regulatory overhang remains unresolved, with management flagging ~$20B in additional capital requirements. Q1 2026 earnings beat was met with a 1.7% share decline, suggesting the market has priced in strong results. The near-term catalyst of H2 2026 regulatory clarity and potential massive buyback is real but not yet dated. Net: excellent franchise, fully priced — mildly attractive on balance.
